title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: policy alert improvements
summary: The roadmap dates, default availability and included subscription licensing are supported. The briefing incorrectly treats configuration permissions as unpublished: Microsoft's permissions table identifies the role groups that configure Communication Compliance policies and settings. The governance checklist also names controls missing from its table.
